summary: A group willing to renegotiate store costs refuses to endorse ballot language that opens the door to repeal.
realLife: Hank Ottinger told the council that Columbians Against Throwaways would consider adjustments but opposed a ballot proposal mentioning repeal.
inGame: The catalog supports city action on bottle deposits. needs: group position and ballot wording.

turns.what: An organizer asks for copies to circulate before the next meeting.
turns.pulledBy: A revision keeps the deposit in force.
turns.writesBack: The organizers take the revised text back to their group.

turns.what: The group sends its own speaker to the ballot hearing.
turns.writesBack: The group's objection appears alongside its offer to negotiate costs.
